title: Repeat-failure tracker: snapshot and off-host copy failures become one owner notice
goal: The second consecutive failure of a class sends one owner notice; the next success sends one recovery notice
acceptance: The tracker is durable across restarts (a restart between two failed nights still counts two)
Notices carry the reason only, never paths with personal data or secrets
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: small durable counter, notice wiring, restart test. Not a measurement.
